name: Workbench P-005 native Windows terminal handoff and exact resume regressions
summary: Six maintained Rust tests passed on the native Windows VM (zero failed/ignored). Seven corresponding Linux tests passed, including execution of the constant runtime script with literal shell-looking Unicode input and child status propagation. Native Windows production PUI compiled successfully. This proves command construction and exact-session guards, not a functioning WSL terminal, installed-app acceptance, or shipment.

prerequisites.custody: Native Get-FileHash matched local test executable SHA256 before executing maintained tests.
prerequisites.runtime: Reuses desktop papercup-runtime WSL distro, installed PUI and psu. Native pui.exe remains the WPF read helper.

linuxLedger.readback: not yet confirmed; server-side capability environment resolved localhost:5432 and failed before query

assertions.evidence: Both normalized operator environment seams forwarded through WSLENV; conflicting path-conversion flags removed; scoped token stays out of argv.
Exact ID/host/owner remain positional, including Unicode and shell-looking owner input. Linux execution negative control observes no injected marker file and preserves exit23.
Native six-test run preserves changed/ambiguous/running/denied row rejection and local versus saved-connection route distinctions.

limits: WSL execution prerequisite remains broken: even /bin/true returns Wsl/Service/0x80072747. Root cause unresolved, owned EI-28077674637451429.
No actual Windows foreground/resume, real vendor response, complete native surface, three-OS installed artifact or shipment claim.
